name: WorldLook
author: Dominik
description: Native sky with mild clock-weighted light and clear coastal water. Correct HHMM time conversion and one session toggle. Water shader embedded in the DLL.
manualTrigger: Ctrl+Shift+F7 toggles light and water together for the session. Configuration is read on startup from UserData/WorldLook/WorldLook.json. F9 diagnostics removed in dev.3.
reportPath: Startup, toggle confirmations and warnings/errors in MelonLoader/Latest.log; existing status.json reports are historical only
limitations: Native sky/clouds/sun/moon/stars remain game-owned. Mild warmth peaks at 06:00 and 18:00, neutral at noon/night. Water targets only Main/Map/StylizedWater2_Ocean and needs camera depth/opaque input requests; those settings do not prove texture contents. Water and ON/OFF owner-accepted on dev.2, 2026-10-24. Visible warmth, night/reload and measured performance remain unverified; dev.3 cleanup has no new gameplay acceptance.
removal: With the game closed, remove Mods/WorldLook.dll and its optional PDB/metadata under UserData/WorldLook. Keep Shared. The old external s1reference.bundle belongs to the archived 0.1.x build.
